name: Style Range
description: Style a cell or a range — 'A1', 'A1:F1', 'D5:D20': { bold, italic, size, color, fill, align: 'left' | 'center' | 'right', valign, wrap, border: true | 'thin' | 'medium', numFmt }. Colours are '#RRGGBB'. For a title, a header row, a highlighted total, a currency column.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet); if (!ws) throw new Error('No sheet named ' + sheet); const argb = (c) => { const h = String(c || '').replace('#', '').toUpperCase(); return h.length === 6 ? 'FF' + h : h; }; const [a, b] = String(range).split(':'); const from = ws.getCell(a), to = ws.getCell(b || a); const st = style || {}; for (let r = from.row; r <= to.row; r++) for (let c = from.col; c <= to.col; c++) { const cell = ws.getCell(r, c); if (st.bold != null || st.italic != null || st.size != null || st.color) cell.font = { ...(cell.font || {}), ...(st.bold != null ? { bold: !!st.bold } : {}), ...(st.italic != null ? { italic: !!st.italic } : {}), ...(st.size ? { size: +st.size } : {}), ...(st.color ? { color: { argb: argb(st.color) } } : {}) }; if (st.fill) cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: argb(st.fill) } }; if (st.align || st.valign || st.wrap != null) cell.alignment = { ...(cell.alignment || {}), ...(st.align ? { horizontal: st.align } : {}), ...(st.valign ? { vertical: st.valign } : {}), ...(st.wrap != null ? { wrapText: !!st.wrap } : {}) }; if (st.border) { const side = { style: st.border === true ? 'thin' : String(st.border) }; cell.border = { top: side, left: side, bottom: side, right: side }; } if (st.numFmt) cell.numFmt = String(st.numFmt); } return workbook; })() }}"}]
